summary.calibration: Encoding subprocess stage; actual policy geometry/audio/timescale. Setup, probe, SSIM, full decode and cleanup excluded from wall time.
limitations: Generated testsrc2 only; no real footage, hardware encoding or product UI.
CRF first pass only; short fixtures do not trigger the real 20 MB two-pass fallback.
Node metrics exclude FFmpeg CPU/RSS; nativeChildMemory separately samples its RSS. Sampling misses short peaks and adds equal observation overhead to strategies.
Synthetic descendants exercise kill primitives, not the complete downloader/FFmpeg application lifecycle.

psdAlpha.classification: Observations, not passing controls or product-path failures
psdAlpha.calibration: 8-bit white-matte composite encoding has RGB quantization; layers use raw RGBA. Very-small RLE alpha behavior is recorded separately. Timed lossless profiles use opaque supplied composites and transparent layers.

summary.calibration: Synthetic operational shapes, not imported product source. Serial batch export and fresh per-item text-composite Worker reflect inspected owners; bounded-2 and raster PSD rewrites are experiments.
limitations: Sharp 0.34.5 only; Linux development 0.33.5 is unchanged and not represented
Generated pattern and default sans-serif only; no real photo/font corpus, Adobe/Photopea or complete product UI certification
PSD V2 normally preserves downloaded bytes; metadata-only readback is product-shaped, full raster roundtrip is a library experiment
Lossless PSD timing uses an opaque supplied composite; independent probes retain observed transparent-composite quantization and very-small RLE alpha behavior
No target-byte quality search, mask polygon unions, installed fonts, paid API, OS cache purge or hardware/display test
Each editor fixture encodes both JPEG backgrounds; digest equivalence is within a platform because available sans-serif glyphs vary

summary.calibration: generic framed journal, checkpoint prefix digest, exact binding deletion, before-image CAS, sync-before-ack
limitations: Generated growth fixtures do not fsync every frame and measure recovery cost only.
Full-text prefix counting reproduces an observed offset-calculation cost, not application source or its complete schema.
Stream/yield is a recovery experiment; directory-sync/compaction durability policy is unchanged.
Crash checks demonstrate process reopen, not power-loss durability.
Recovery variants run in isolated children; metrics exclude child startup, fixture generation, verification and cleanup.
OS cache is not purged; before-digest checks omit application-specific ownership, admission and capacity rules.

summary.calibration: Real ipcMain.invoke/contextBridge, Chromium image decode and native clipboard; measurements end after decoded pixels are available
limits: Generated RGB PNG only
File URLs may hit Chromium decoded/file caches within a sample; OS caches are not reset
Main RSS excludes renderer peaks; renderer working-set observations are KiB and post-operation only
GPU disabled; no product rendering/input certification

summary.calibration: Fresh Electron app/defaultSession; controlled PAC resolves Node Undici ProxyAgent; deadline begins before resolution and spans complete body. Scoped dispatchers released after body completion/cancellation.
limitations: Loopback HTTP only; simulated PAC configuration is not actual OS system proxy validation.
No HTTPS/TLS, SOCKS, DNS rebinding, public target validation, real network, updater, Worker or paid API.
Scoped dispatchers differ from the product shared agent cache; no claim about settings rollback or live cached agent retirement.
Main metrics include generated origin/proxy work and exclude Chromium network process CPU/RSS.
Explicit loopback bypass removal is a fixture requirement, not a proposed product proxy setting.

summary.calibration: Real Electron requestSingleInstanceLock and readiness/loopback primitives, std-only compiled Rust client and Node client
limits: Generic fixture CLI, not the product Rust CLI or installation resolver
Synthetic app has no product startup modules, recovery data or visible window
Parent Node RSS/CPU excludes Electron, Chromium and CLI child resources
GPU disabled; no sleep/wake or updater certification

OS cache is not purged; before-digest checks omit application-specific ownership, admission and capacity rules.
